definition: Thermosphere mass density at the GOCE satellite location
description:
The product contains thermosphere mass density at the GOCE satellite location.

GOCE (March 2009 to its re-entry in November 2013) flew in a very low orbit, at about 255-270 km, and used drag-free control. Neutral mass density comes from the non-gravitational accelerations measured by the gradiometer accelerometers, combined with the ion thruster activation data and star camera attitude. The product belongs to the multi-mission thermosphere density series produced by Delft University of Technology, alongside CH_DNS_ACC_2_ (CHAMP), GR_DNSxACC_2_ (GRACE) and GF_DNSxACC_2_ (GRACE-FO).
